item.title: Built Different: Honey Badger Wars And Lion vs Crocodile | Animal Fight
item.description:
Made with Restream Studio. Livestream on 30+ platforms at once via https://restream.io
Built Different: A honey badger doesn't back down from anything — not even one of Africa's largest constrictor snakes. In Part 1 of Honey Badger Wars, we follow Scar defending his territory against an African rock python, the confrontation that kicks off the entire series.
🎬 Continue the series: Part 3 — The Den Part 4 — What They Try Instead The African predators survive in a place where only the strongest survive.
